parent_rationale: reviewed trace variant has best observed development velocity among current retained candidates; this is development-guided candidate design, not validation selection
volume_objective: unchanged trace parent sqrt(sigma) normalized value plus gradient errors and supervised trace-error lambda1
boundary_objective: sum sigma_r^2 integral_cylinder |(Gpred_r+Gpred_r.T-Gteacher_r-Gteacher_r.T) n_body|^2 ds/D divided by global retained TRAIN teacher symmetric-traction energy
weight_rationale: one additional independently normalized supervised boundary channel; prospective unit coefficient, not an optimum or a physics guarantee
teacher: first four original TRAIN FE POD columns; no Reynolds-specific force or development targets
parent_initial_replay: old trace combined objective must match accepted parent selected objective; base/trace/traction/new combined separately retained
initial_parameter_gradients: persist base, supervised trace and unweighted traction vectors, their Euclidean norms and combined norm
selection: minimum accepted initial/updated NEW combined full-training objective; no cross-objective reduction claim
hardware_selection: fresh GresUsed and queue feasibility before packet; no performance comparison inferred
retention: complete trial/accepted/evaluation JSONL, periodic and selected full state, all pending/completed/incomplete events, selected uncached full volume AND cylinder replay
resource_status: actual packet output-row bound and input/resource inventory pending; do not submit
